# Topology_Induced_Representation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learned representation in a neural network that is shaped by the underlying connectivity topology of the network architecture. In TCC, this concept links the physical/logical topology of computing systems to the quality of learned representations, enabling topology-aware optimization.
